// CASE swift_array_literal expect=fire
func inOrder<T>(_ items: [T], _ step: (T) async throws -> Void, reason: String) async throws {
  for item in items {
    consume(try await step(item), [await save(item)])
  }
}
// CASE swift_tuple expect=fire
func inOrder<T>(_ items: [T], _ step: (T) async throws -> Void, reason: String) async throws {
  for item in items {
    consume(try await step(item), (await save(item), 1))
  }
}
// CASE swift_nil_coalesce expect=fire
func inOrder<T>(_ items: [T], _ step: (T) async throws -> Void, reason: String) async throws {
  for item in items {
    consume(try await step(item), cache[item] ?? (await save(item)))
  }
}
// CASE swift_subscript expect=fire
func inOrder<T>(_ items: [T], _ step: (T) async throws -> Void, reason: String) async throws {
  for item in items {
    consume(try await step(item), table[await key(item)])
  }
}
// CASE swift_cast expect=fire
func inOrder<T>(_ items: [T], _ step: (T) async throws -> Void, reason: String) async throws {
  for item in items {
    consume(try await step(item), await save(item) as Any)
  }
}
// CASE swift_try_bang expect=fire
func inOrder<T>(_ items: [T], _ step: (T) async throws -> Void, reason: String) async throws {
  for item in items {
    consume(try await step(item), try! await save(item))
  }
}
// CASE swift_trailing_closure_awaited expect=fire
func inOrder<T>(_ items: [T], _ step: (T) async throws -> Void, reason: String) async throws {
  for item in items {
    consume(try await step(item), await run { await save(item) })
  }
}
// CASE swift_assign expect=fire
func inOrder<T>(_ items: [T], _ step: (T) async throws -> Void, reason: String) async throws {
  for item in items {
    cache[item] = (try await step(item), await save(item))
  }
}
// CASE swift_nested_interp expect=fire
func inOrder<T>(_ items: [T], _ step: (T) async throws -> Void, reason: String) async throws {
  for item in items {
    consume(try await step(item), "a \("b \(await save(item))")")
  }
}
